name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from an edge and follows the finger: drag it back toward its edge and it goes, let go early and it settles back. The bottom sheet of a phone app, on the web. Base UI's Drawer owns the gesture, the open state, the focus trap, page…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/drawer

Installed to `components/ui/drawer.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/drawer';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/drawer

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
